stations.title: Kasimir
stations.note: He adds the drifts in his head.

stations.title: Timing bench
stations.text: A drift for every clock, added up by hand.

captions: Kasimir writes down how many seconds each clock gained on the timing bench.
He adds them up in his head at the end of the day, and some days he misses one.
You write loops that go through every value of a vector, and one that changes them.
Now every clock on the bench is counted, the fastest is found, and the list is numbered.
The bench is counted for him. Next, Dorrit wants functions that pass whole lists around.
